about: The shared test vector of a bare `2.` link (web/src/lib/playground/project/overlay-link.ts): the files and `select` of overlay-link-vector.json with `base: "bare"`, so the link opens over the starting project without its Counter sample (`bareProject()` in template.ts). rocketh-website hand-ports the encoder (web/open-in-playground/overlay-link.js) and keeps a copy of the decoder in its tests, both held to this file and to overlay-link-vector.json: encodeOverlay(files, select, {base: "bare"}) must give exactly `value`. A change to the encoding changes these files and both repositories together.
